## Summary

- The Console has a shared Tag vocabulary. Operators assign Tags to Business Entities and Data Channels, filter those lists, bulk-edit the current page, and open the records that carry a Tag. Each user can save a personal filter on the Entity list and the Channel list.
- `super_admin` receives `tag:read` and `tag:write`. `operator` and custom Roles do not until an administrator adds them. Assigning Tags uses `entity:write` or `channel:write` and does not require `tag:write`.
- Business Domain is retired. The Console screen, the Business Domain HTTP API, and the MCP tools `list_business_domains` and `create_business_domain` are gone. Object semantics no longer accept or return a business domain.
- A Data Channel can repeat a container body with an Until node until that node's condition is true. Dataset Query and Materialize may run inside a container, and each round keeps its own dataset. A new successful execution stores its full output, including when a Batch Read is an ancestor.
- Channel runs add a Node Sample, container-round reads, and an optional scope on Template Preview. Execution records include an input preview.
- Controlled Query, Catalog Sample, and MCP `run_sql` return a `declarations` array beside `columns`. A temporal cell keeps its source category and is not rewritten as a platform Instant. Dataset column references add `temporal_kind`, `precision`, and `nullable`.
- Entity timestamp attributes are returned as UTC instants at second precision. Audit list bounds `from` and `to` must include an offset.

## Operator notes

- Upgrade from v0.2.0. v0.1.6 and v0.1.9 were tagged and are not installable. Do not install them.
- No new keys in `.env.example`. Leave the live `.env` in place. `ENTITY_OWNER_PASSWORD` and `ENTITY_READER_PASSWORD` remain required, URL-safe, and distinct.
- Compose still mounts named volume `refraq_pg` at `/var/lib/postgresql`. Default PGDATA is `/var/lib/postgresql/18/docker`. A site already on that mount, including one upgraded through v0.1.10 or v0.2.0, keeps its cluster. A site that only used the published v0.1.8 asset must still copy the anonymous-volume cluster onto `refraq_pg` before `up -d`, using the command in the v0.1.10 notes. Do not run `docker compose down -v`. Do not restore `/var/lib/postgresql/data`.
- Replace `docker-compose.yaml`, then `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. The new image tag recreates `ensure-entity-db`. That one-shot still prepares `entity_data`, `entity_access`, `acl`, and `channel_dataset`. api and worker still refuse to start while any of those four is missing. No new schema is required. Beat now restarts unless stopped.
- API start runs Foundation Upgrade from `0068_retire_business_domain` through `0072_saved_filters`. `0068` deletes semantics-change rows whose `field_name` is `business_domain_id`, deletes audit events whose `resource_type` is `business_domain`, drops `catalog_objects.business_domain_id`, and drops `business_domains`. Catalog objects, other audit events, Entity rows, and channel rows stay. `0069` adds nullable execution input columns and an empty round table. `0070` through `0072` create empty Tag and saved-filter tables. Those unique keys are on the new tables. The upgrade does not insert into an existing unique key.
- Callers of the removed Business Domain HTTP routes fail. `set_object_semantics` no longer accepts `business_domain_code`. Webhook delivery is unchanged.
- A stored execution output that already carries the preview envelope still reads as preview-only. New successful executions store the full output.
- Rolling back to an older compose after these migrations is not supported.
